status: PASS of physical pin contract, part identity and conditional arithmetic
idle_exclusions: LDO loaded ground current, transistor/PCB/cap leakage, host gate input load; not a guaranteed total idle specification
scope: Transient values depend on assumed delay/current/C/ESR and PNP saturation. Pulse graph is single-pulse, no assembly thermal proof.
release_gates: Actual returned motor energy/current and whether lowering can regenerate continuously.
100us comparator/driver response is a planning stimulus, not a guaranteed timing bound.
TMP302 to resistor-bank thermal coupling, hottest-element gradient and trip timing are unmeasured.
Sustained back-drive after thermal cutoff or disconnected pack is unsupported; motor coast alone does not absorb that energy.
Hot startup and brownout must not create a false latch or delayed unsafe clamp.
Two shorted power FETs or failed thermostat supply defeat independent cutoff; no functional-safety claim.
Pulse repetition, MOSFET switching SOA, leakage, trace inductance/overshoot, capacitor ESR/aging, printed-case temperatures and EMC require hardware qualification.
Cold restart after a trip requires pack power removal and service diagnosis, not automatic firmware retry.
